name: vault.remember
description: Commits one claim through the gate, the same as vault.claims.upsert. To correct a claim you wrote, use vault.claims.correct.
example: if ("actor_ref" in me) await vault.remember({ subject_ref: me.person_ref ?? me.actor_ref, predicate: "experiment.run_result.d1a", value: { run: "1127-0912-d1a", verdict: "pass" }, confidence: 0.9, source: "observed" });
